description.value:
Prerequisite: Cyber-Megacity, Forge World, or Automated Shipyard

Raised in the heart of dense network server grids, automated manufacturing lines, and machine infrastructure.

  • Insulated Conduits: You have Resistance to Lightning (Ion) damage.
  • Tech-Native: You gain proficiency in the Technology skill or with Slicer's Tools, and you can fluently read, write, and transmit SIGNAL (machine binary packet code).

system.requirements: Cyber-Megacity, Forge World, or Automated Shipyard
